title: Miner and sticker registry
description: Off-chain mirror of MinerRegistry (PRD 4.1 shared data). Owned jointly: B writes device keys, C registers on-chain, A reads sticker IDs. Cross-miner uniqueness of sticker_ids is checked by scripts/validate.py and enforced on-chain.

chain_id.description: EVM chain the on-chain registry lives on (80002 = Polygon Amoy, 31337 = local Hardhat).

miner_status.description: pending = application approved but not yet on-chain; active = can mint; suspended = admin paused; revoked = permanently removed.

location.description: Registered install location and the anti-cheat geofence around it.

geohash.description: Geohash of lat/lon (precision 7-9), as passed to registerMiner.

geofence_m.description: Max distance from the registered spot before gps_out_of_geofence fires (PRD: 50 m).

device_address.description: Ethereum address derived from the device public key; what ecrecover returns for a valid attestation.

device_public_key.description: secp256k1 public key, 0x-prefixed, uncompressed (65 bytes, 0x04...) or compressed (33 bytes, 0x02/0x03...).

sticker_ids.description: The 20 ArUco IDs shipped with this miner. Each ID belongs to exactly one miner.

sticker_set_hash.description: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint16[] sticker_ids sorted ascending)), as passed to registerMiner.

label.description: Display name, e.g. 'Demo rig' or 'Virtual miner B'.

virtual.description: True for a simulated miner (e.g. the second miner used in the sticker-reuse demo).
